name: b_amd_world_labs_8b_deal
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026. Story: AMD $8.2B World Labs Acquisition: Rationale, Dilution & Competitive Impact. Related tickers: AMD, NVDA, INTC.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

Why this needs follow-up: AMD announced an all-stock $8.2B acquisition of World Labs with year-end close expected, but the notes contain no detail on World Labs' products, revenue, or why AMD is paying this price—nor any analyst reaction on accretion/dilution or competitive positioning vs NVDA.

ANSWER EACH QUESTION (run a separate search for each):
- What products or AI model capabilities does World Labs provide that AMD cited as the strategic rationale for the $8.2 billion all-stock acquisition announced October 5 2026?
- How many AMD shares will be issued in the World Labs deal at current prices, and what EPS dilution have sell-side analysts estimated for fiscal 2027?
- Which analysts raised or lowered AMD price targets on October 5 2026 in response to the World Labs acquisition announcement, and what were their new targets?

Name every stock affected by this story with its move, analyst notes that name winners and losers
(firm, rating, PT), exact figures (deal values, estimates, dates), and the latest status as of the
cutoff. Prefer Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC, WSJ, Barron's, MarketWatch, company releases, filings.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or sub-topic:

## TICKER or Sub-topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## World Labs / Strategic rationale `[Products and AI capabilities]`

- AMD announced a definitive agreement on **September 28, 2026** to acquire World Labs for approximately **$8.2 billion in an all-stock transaction**, with closing expected by **year-end 2026**, subject to regulatory approval and customary conditions. (GlobeNewswire/AMD, Sep. 28, 2026; reported Oct. 5)
- World Labs develops **spatial-intelligence models** that generate, reconstruct, and simulate interactive **3D environments** from **text, images, video, and 3D data**. (AMD company release, Sep. 28, 2026)
- World Labs’ **Marble** platform generates persistent, explorable 3D worlds from text, images, and video. (Barchart, Oct. 1, 2026)
- World Labs’ **Atlas** is a multimodal world model pretrained from scratch for text, images, video, and 3D data; World Labs added Atlas on **September 1, 2026**. (Barchart, Oct. 1, 2026)
- World Labs is developing technology for **robotic learning and simulation**, including applications involving robotics, autonomous systems, cinematic production, and physical-world simulation. (AMD company release, Sep. 28, 2026; Barchart, Oct. 1, 2026)
- AMD said World Labs’ researchers and model experts would help AMD develop **AI hardware, software, and systems** around emerging models and applications, including **reasoning, robotics, simulation, and physical AI**. (AMD company release, Sep. 28, 2026)
- AMD CEO **Lisa Su** said access to frontier-model research would help AMD anticipate future computing requirements and shape its hardware, software, and system roadmaps. (Benzinga/TradingView, Oct. 1, 2026)
- World Labs founder **Fei-Fei Li** is expected to join AMD as **executive vice president and chief scientist**, reporting to Lisa Su, after closing. (AMD company release, Sep. 28, 2026)

## AMD `[Deal value, shares and dilution]`

- The transaction value is approximately **$8.2 billion**, payable entirely in AMD common stock; AMD expects the deal to close by **year-end 2026**. (AMD company release, Sep. 28, 2026)
- AMD had **not disclosed a fixed number of shares** to be issued as of the **October 5, 2026, 12:20 ET** cutoff; the final share count is calculated using AMD’s **volume-weighted average price over trading days immediately before closing**. (MarketBeat, Oct. 1, 2026)
- Using AMD’s reported **$567.63** October 2 reference price, an $8.2 billion equity value implies approximately **14.45 million AMD shares**: \( \$8.2\text{ billion} \div \$567.63 \). (MarketBeat, Oct. 2, 2026)
- Using the October 2 regular-session closing price of approximately **$569.96**, the implied issuance is approximately **14.39 million shares**: \( \$8.2\text{ billion} \div \$569.96 \). (Search result reporting AMD market data, Oct. 2, 2026)
- No sell-side fiscal-2027 EPS-dilution estimate was identified in the available October 2–5 reporting before the **12:20 ET** cutoff.
- The deal’s all-stock structure dilutes existing AMD holders but preserves AMD cash for product development. (MarketBeat, Oct. 1, 2026)
- AMD’s potential World Labs issuance is separate from the **up to 160 million AMD shares** issuable under AMD’s OpenAI warrant agreement if milestones are met. (Business Insider, Oct. 1, 2026)

## AMD `[Analyst actions and price targets]`

- **Rosenblatt Securities — Buy, $700 price target:** Rosenblatt reiterated its Buy rating and **$700** target on **September 29, 2026**, citing World Labs’ potential to expand AMD’s AI software, modeling, simulation, system-level, and robotics capabilities. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 4, 2026)
- **StoneX — Buy, $685 price target:** Analyst **Cody Acree** reiterated a Buy rating and **$685** target on **September 29, 2026**. (TradingView/Benzinga, Oct. 1, 2026)
- **Bank of America — Buy, $620 → $720:** Analyst **Vivek Arya** raised AMD’s target from **$620 to $720** on **September 25, 2026**, while retaining Buy; the cited rationale was higher CPU pricing driven by agentic-AI demand rather than a new October 5 World Labs-specific revision. (Ad-hoc News, Oct. 4, 2026)
- No analyst price-target change published on **October 5, 2026, by 12:20 ET** was identified in the available reporting as directly responding to the World Labs announcement.
- The reported analyst consensus target was **$648.07** in one October 1 market-data summary and **$618.84** in another October 1 report; the reports did not reconcile the difference. (Business Insider, Oct. 1, 2026; TradingView/Benzinga, Oct. 1, 2026)

## AMD `[Stock move and competitive positioning]`

- AMD shares gained **1.77%** in the cited October 1 report following the World Labs acquisition coverage; the report did not provide a regular-session timestamp for that move. (Ad-hoc News, Oct. 1, 2026)
- AMD shares were reported at **€567.35**, up **3.50%**, in Lang & Schwarz trading on **October 2, 2026**; this was an off-exchange European quote rather than AMD’s U.S. regular-session close. (Ad-hoc News, Oct. 3, 2026)
- World Labs’ spatial-intelligence capabilities were described as giving AMD exposure to **physical AI**, while Nvidia was reported to have existing technologies including **Cosmos** and **Omniverse** in that area. (Business Insider, Oct. 1, 2026)
- AMD’s stated competitive objective is to use World Labs’ model expertise to shape AMD’s future chips, software, and systems rather than compete directly with OpenAI or Anthropic as a standalone model provider. (MarketBeat, Oct. 1, 2026)

## NVDA `[Competitive impact]`

- Nvidia was reported to have agreed to acquire model platform **Hugging Face for $12.9 billion**, providing the competitive transaction context for AMD’s **$8.2 billion** World Labs acquisition. (Barchart, Oct. 1, 2026)
- Nvidia’s **Cosmos** and **Omniverse** platforms were identified as existing Nvidia technologies related to physical AI and spatial or simulated environments. (Business Insider, Oct. 1, 2026)
- No NVDA price move, analyst rating change, or price-target revision published within the specified window was identified in the available reporting.

## INTC `[Related ticker]`

- No Intel (**INTC**) price move, analyst rating change, or price-target revision tied to AMD’s World Labs acquisition was identified in the available reporting through **October 5, 2026, 12:20 ET**.
